section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Cruise Control System
title: INSPECTION OF SPEED SENSOR CIRCUIT

content.description: Diagnostic flowchart for speed sensor circuit inspection starting from turning ignition switch on, proceeding through ground connection inspection, speed sensor circuit inspection, and speed sensor operation inspection

steps.title: INSPECT GROUND CONNECTION
steps.text: Disconnect connector from combination meter. Is there continuity between terminal C-6 (analog meter) or A-10 (digital meter) of wire harness side connector and body ground?
steps.yes_action: Short circuit in wire harness between terminal C-6 (analog meter) or A-10 (digital meter) and body ground.

steps.title: INSPECT SPEED SENSOR CIRCUIT
steps.text: Disconnect connector from combination meter. Is there continuity between terminal C-7 (analog meter) or A-12 (digital meter) of wire harness side connector and terminal 6 of computer?
steps.no_action: Open circuit in wire harness between terminal C-7 (analog meter) or A-12 (digital meter) of combination meter and terminal 6 of computer.

steps.title: INSPECT SPEED SENSOR OPERATION
steps.text: Is speed sensor operation normal? (See page BE-83)
